title: Program Relief on Early-Termination Rebate Forfeitures — Contract Pricing Agreement
content:
Program relief on an early-termination rebate forfeiture — Contract Pricing Agreement

The program relief follows the programs the customer keeps with Corbett: whether the customer holds an active StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program (a StockSmart program whose status is active) and an active VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machine (a VendPoint machine whose status is active), as those programs' own records show. The relief is subtracted from the termination period's net rebate before the forfeiture's floor at 0.00 and its rounding to the cent are applied.

| Active StockSmart program | Active VendPoint machine | Program relief |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 0.1 times the termination period's net rebate |
| Yes | No | 0.05 times the termination period's net rebate |
| No | Yes | 0.05 times the termination period's net rebate |
| No | No | No program relief |

Hypothetical example: a customer keeping one active StockSmart program and no active VendPoint machine, on a net rebate of 1500.00, takes 0.05 times 1500.00, which is 75.00.
